summary: Ultragenyx filed a routine 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that the FDA granted standard full approval of FAYUVI (rebisufligene etisparvovec-hopf), also known as UX111, for pediatric patients with mucopolysaccharidosis type IIIA (MPS IIIA, Sanfilippo syndrome Type A). The approval, announced September 17, 2026, marks the first FDA-approved treatment for Sanfilippo Type A and Ultragenyx's second gene therapy approval; the company also received a Priority Review Voucher. No transaction, price, stake, premium, advisor, or structural mechanics were stated. This is a regulatory milestone, not a special situation.
